items.docs: The Buyer requests a list of Quotes from the Seller based on a set of filter criteria (as described in MEF 80).  For each Quote returned, the Seller also provides a Quote Identifier that uniquely identifies this Quote within the Seller. The order of the elements returned to the Buyer is defined by the Seller (e.g. natural order) and does not change between the pages.
